process_images_for_multimodal_model: process a list of PIL images using pad or anyres aspect ratio strategies for a multimodal model
select_best_resolution_for_image: select the best fit resolution from a list of candidates based on an original image size
resize_and_pad_image_to_target: resize a PIL image to a target resolution while maintaining aspect ratio and padding with black
divide_image_into_patches: divide a PIL image into a list of smaller square patches of a specified size
tokenize_prompt_with_image_tokens: tokenize a text prompt containing image placeholders by inserting image token indices at split points
